## Issue setup checklist

<!--
For the author or maintainers.
Complete applicable items and delete the rest.
If you lack permission to update these fields, leave them for a maintainer.
GitHub uses labels to categorize issues; separate tags are not needed.
-->

- [ ] Apply relevant labels.
- [ ] Add the issue to the appropriate GitHub Project.
- [ ] Set Project fields, such as status, priority, and iteration.
- [ ] Assign an owner, if known.
- [ ] Set a milestone, if applicable.
- [ ] Link related PRs, parent issues, sub-issues, or dependencies.
